messages:
anna: Heads up — the audit e2e validation started failing in CI after the KMS RBAC tweak. Build: https://ci.internal/12345. Failing test: audit_event_validator::e2e::customer_events.

mike_rt: seeing this too. Error snippet?

anna: paste from CI log:
```
thread=main level=error msg=validation failed path=events/2026-03-19/remote_kms_use.json reason=unexpected field 'actor_role'
expected: [timestamp, event_type, actor_id, resource_id, details]
found: [timestamp, event_type, actor_id, actor_role, resource_id, details]
```

sarah_p: oh — actor_role was added in the RBAC change to include the role for audit traces. We added it to the producer side but didn't publish a schema bump.

kevin_infra: that aligns with the rollout notes. @sarah_p did we intend for actor_role to be optional?

sarah_p: yes intended optional, but the event generator currently emits it always for KMS operations. I can change generator to omit when unknown, or we can update validator to accept the new field as optional.

mike_rt: quick triage: is this just CI noise or could it break customer-facing audit exports?

anna: customer-facing exports use the same validator in the export pipeline. If validator is strict, it will reject payloads that include actor_role and block exports — potential customer impact. Need fast mitigation.

ci-bot: Build 12345 finished with status: failed (tests: 1 failed). See artifacts: https://ci.internal/12345/artifacts/validator.log

deploy-bot: Canary deploy of change 2334 (rbac: include-role) went to sandbox at 2026-03-19T12:10Z

kevin_infra: short-term options:
- revert the RBAC producer change (quick rollback)
- patch validator to accept unknown fields (lenient mode)
- bump schema version and update golden fixtures + validator tests

mike_rt: prefer a patch to validator for lenient parsing for now, because rollback would remove useful telemetry. We can make acceptance of actor_role opt-in via config flag.

anna: agreed. We should also add an e2e test that asserts exports succeed when optional fields are present.

sarah_p: I'll open a PR to make actor_role optional in the json-schema and add casing to generators to emit null instead of empty. Plan: PR #4567.

mike_rt: add a CI-only toggle to the validator so we can unbreak current pipeline immediately. Something like: VALIDATOR_MODE=permissive for the export job. Then follow with schema bump and proper tests.

anna: created issue: ENGSEC-1021 — "Audit e2e: actor_role schema mismatch causing CI failures". Assigning to @sarah_p.

sarah_p: working on PR, will also update golden fixtures under testdata/golden/audit/*. Will run local validator with:
```
./tools/audit-validate --schema schemas/audit_v1.json --file testdata/local/remote_kms_use.json
```

kevin_infra: once PR is up, can someone run the compatibility test matrix? We need to ensure old consumers still validate. Use the compatibility harness: `./ci/compat-run.sh --matrix audit`

mike_rt: also add a regression test that exercises the KMS path with actor_role present and absent. CI should cover both.

anna: timeline: temporary permissive flag today, PR by EOD for schema change, compatibility run tomorrow, rollback only if we see export failures in production.

sarah_p: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/audit/merge_requests/4567 — includes schema change + golden fixture update + test. Asking for review from @mike_rt and @kevin_infra.

mike_rt: reviewing now. Small comment on test naming.

kevin_infra: approving once we confirm compat matrix passes. I'll run the matrix after merge.

anna: thanks. Follow-up items: (1) patch CI job to set VALIDATOR_MODE=permissive (security-approved?), (2) add regression in e2e suite, (3) update release notes and customer-facing audit schema docs.

mike_rt: note on security: permissive mode must not be enabled for production export pipelines unless schema is validated downstream. We need a short SLO check that flags exported events missing required fields.

anna: agreed, @sarah_p will add a monitoring alert to the audit pipeline for rejected exports.

sarah_p: alert created: AUDIT_EXPORT_REJECT_RATE > 0.5% for 5m -> channel #eng-oncall.

ci-bot: Job artifact: validator.log shows 1 failure (same as snippet).

anna: OK closing this thread for now — action items in ENGSEC-1021 and MR 4567. If anyone sees export problems, escalate to #incidents. :white_check_mark:
